variants.A: Read-only prospective selector on saved v5b checkpoints. No new PGD.
variants.B: Compressed answer-aligned margin plus Full sequence-margin protection. Same selector.
variants.C: Variant B plus one page-level soft selection-stability term from the real FastV last-query score. Same selector.

eligible_if: full decoded text equals clean full text
selector.rank: ascending compressed margin, then earlier step
selector.replay: mandatory after selection; failure does not trigger a new pick

variant_b_loss.L_comp: untruncated mean token margin of the clean Full answer on the real FastV path
variant_b_loss.m_t: logit(clean_full_token_t) - max logit of any other token, including EOS
variant_b_loss.kappa_t: max(0, min(m_clean_t, 1.0)), frozen from the clean Full teacher-forced state
variant_b_loss.L_full_seq: mean over tokens of relu(kappa_t - m_adv_t)

variant_c_loss.L_selection: L1 distance between page-level softmax masses of the real FastV last-query attention scores and the same masses at the clean image

scale_rule.state: delta=0 on the clean aux page
scale_rule.one_fallback: if a calibration gradient L2 is below 1e-6, recompute that term at a fixed +1/255 shift and use that L2; no second fallback and no result-based retune

version_choice: drop variants that miss the common gate
C is chosen only if it passes its stability gate and its strict count is at least B
otherwise B if it passes and strict is at least A
